# Change: 005 - A checkout conflict
Change ID: 005
Change Folder: 005-conflict

## Capability Specs

All living specs. Read the requirements this change writes or whose code it uses, not whole specs: `osq spec <capability>` lists them and `osq spec <capability> <requirement>` prints one.

- openspec/specs/alpha/spec.md

## Brief

### Goal

Conflict in the checkout.

## This repository's record

This repository's measured record is too small (fewer than 5 tasks).

## Steering

osq halted this change and asks you to revise its plan.

### change conflict (sync_conflict)
Evidence: <scratch>/repo/openspec/changes/005-conflict/.run/regressed/change.md

```
Merging trunk conflicted in src/one.txt.
```

The change runs in <scratch>/repo; read its code there. Edit only <scratch>/repo/openspec/changes/005-conflict.
Approval restarts osq/005-conflict from trunk, and every task runs again.
Every task runs again after the restart. Revise any task the conflict shows is wrong.
Run `osq lint 005` and fix every finding. A human runs `osq approve 005`, and the run continues from the first task that is not done.
